system.description:
You know how to make and deploy a Rifle Turret.

At Level 7 you learn a turret of your choice; at Level 11 another turret of your choice; at Level 15 another turret of your choice (4 turret types known total).

[M] Turrets are Small, stationary objects that last until the end of initiative, until you deploy another one, or until they take one instance of damage equal to your LVL (destroyed). A turret fires its basic effect when deployed and when you spend 1 Action to activate it. You can spend 2 Actions and 1 Toolbelt scrap to activate a turret's Toolbelt special ability, after which the turret is destroyed. Which turrets you know and their deployment are tracked by the module — see the GM notes on this feature.
